notes: Undo for drawing, and a cleaner closing curve. Pen, Line, Path and Pattern fill: every change to a shape you are drawing (a point, dragging a point or handle, closing, deleting) can now be undone and redone step by step with Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y. Closing a shape by clicking the first point and dragging now curves only the closing line; the first point and its other line stay where they are. Also: the brush preview shows in the 2D view, and Ctrl + right-drag resizes the brush there.
